title: BINN-VAE
description: BINN-VAE is a repository that contains the code and models to apply a Biologically Informed Neural Network Variational AutoEncoder for the use in single cell sequencing data. The model generates a Gene Ontology Directed Acyclic Graph from a input obo file and gene annotations. Based on this graph a Variational AutoEncoder can be trained on a input single cell sequencing matrix (.h5ad).
